claim: In the matching retail DLL, the two InitReferee state-machine paths that directly call FACT-0066 RefereeMan.CreateReferee are closed from exact method bodies. MatchMain.InitReferee (0x06004919) is an exact 8-byte wrapper that constructs <InitReferee>c__Iterator5. Its MoveNext (0x06007425) is an exact 523-byte body with raw PC cases 0/1/2. On initial entry it loads GlobalWork.MatchSetting, returns false when RefereeID < 0, calls RefereeMan.CreateReferee, and when RefereeID >= 10000 checks SaveData.GetEditRefereeData; a null result stores raw RefereeID 0. The RefereeID < 10000 path loads preset referee parameter/costume data; the other path loads edit RefereeData.Prm/appearanceData. Both converge on costumeData[0], call Referee.Init(costume,formSize), then yield FormRen.InitTexture_Async(costume,null). PC case 1 calls FormRen.InitSprite(0), writes TargetPlIdx=-1, PlDir=0 and hasRight=1, yields Menu_SoundManager.LoadAsync_RefereeVoice(RefePrm.voiceType), and PC case 2 calls Referee.ReqRefereeAnm(1106) before final false return. MatchMainCp.InitReferee (0x0600493F) is another exact 8-byte wrapper constructing <InitReferee>c__Iterator3. Its MoveNext (0x06007443) is an exact 303-byte body that only executes its main path when the prior $PC value is zero; it performs the same RefereeID negative gate, CreateReferee call, >=10000 edit-data null fallback to raw 0, and <10000 versus >=10000 parameter/appearance selection, then uses costumeData[0], calls Referee.Init, writes TargetPlIdx=-1, PlDir=0 and hasRight=1, calls ReqRefereeAnm(1106), and if Referee.Shadow is non-null calls Shadow.SetActive(false), then returns false. These exact paths preserve their differing async/state-machine behavior without treating their names as proof of broader gameplay meaning.
